replay.entry: Drive these public items on o1: mixdog-ai/src/service/model_proxy.rs:76 without_attachment_references; mixdog-core-domains/src/domains/ai_admin/model_proxy_service.rs:184 ModelProxyService::call (the `modelProxy/run` request: admission by payload size, then the run and its typed events).

1,000 advertised ids never produce more.maxSnapshotEntries / advertised / rounds: no snapshot exists on the typed protocol: each call is its own modelProxy/run request (mixdog-app-protocol/src/methods.rs:4338); the server does not count them against its class cap (mixdog-app-server/src/server.rs, the cap of modelProxy/run), as Node's host has none: the recorded burst of case 4 is admitted whole (mixdog-app-server tests/admission.rs the_recorded_burst_and_refusal_reach_the_real_model_proxy_service_from_the_wire); each call is one frame of at most maxInboundFrameBytes, tested by a_peer_holds_at_most_its_in_flight_runs_each_one_bounded_frame

a burst of sends all run, with no rate o.hostRunningAfter: ModelProxyService::close returns at once: no run left
a burst of sends all run, with no rate o.sends / results[].content: 30 concurrent modelProxy/run calls on ModelProxyService; each answers `sent` and its textDelta events fold to the content

a stored-attachment reference from a ser.pcSecretBase64 / readBackHere / stored: the PC's own store: ProxyRunner (model_proxy.rs:864) holds no attachment store; asserted absent from what the provider saw
a stored-attachment reference from a ser.request.messages[0].content[1] (image wi: unrepresentable: ProxyImage (mixdog-app-protocol/src/v2/model_proxy.rs:55) is base64, url or file id; the three typed forms are sent and reach the provider unchanged
a stored-attachment reference from a ser.request.messages[0].content[2].content[0: a tool message's ProxyPart::File { source: Unavailable (v2/model_proxy.rs:67), filename } -> the provider's text part, compared with providerSaw[0].content[2].content[0].text

callbacks reach the server only allowlis.allowlistedCallbacks: the CALLBACKS table of the replay test: each Node callback and the ProxyEvent variants that carry it, keys compared in order
callbacks reach the server only allowlis.deltas (onStreamDelta of a 200-char stri: unrepresentable: onStreamDelta's kind is the ProxyProgress enum (v2/model_proxy.rs:596), never free text
callbacks reach the server only allowlis.providerName / accounts / tools / networ: the recorder's inputs: the provider and its two accounts, the two tools it was sent (the first has an invalid schema, its name carries the credential-shaped text) and, per network attempt, whether the server's secret hook was known; the replay reads the tools and the second account's id from them
callbacks reach the server only allowlis.result.content: the textDelta events of the run, folded; the provider is scripted with the recorder's own 'ok', and the run's whole ordered event list is compared in the order Node's wire recorded the callbacks, which is the order a real send raises them (see the recorder's comment: the request body's tool report at each account attempt, the switch between attempts, the committed change last): tool excluded, account switching, tool excluded, account changed (onStreamDelta has no typed event); the text and the scripted stream's completed event close the list
callbacks reach the server only allowlis.result.providerMetadata: carried as ProxyEvent::AccountRouting { provider, accountId, sessionAccountId } (v2/model_proxy.rs) by a pool that stamps it, and back on the history as ProxyMessage.accountRouting: without the history carry the next turn of a conversation through the proxy would not be kept on the account that served the last (Node's pool reads it from the history, account-pool.mjs sessionAccountId / customKeyServedBy) and would land on another key, with its cache and quota. The typed completion has no other provider metadata. The provider of this case is scripted and raises no AccountRouting, so the replay's event list is only the recorded callbacks and the account id of the roster's switch stays on this PC; the history carry is tested by the_account_that_served_an_answer_rides_on_the_history (model_proxy_tests.rs) and the key binding by the recorded gateway cases (registry/gateway_replay.rs)
callbacks reach the server only allowlis.result.secretHookKnown / secretHookCalle: unrepresentable: a typed request (ProxyOptions, v2/model_proxy.rs:194) carries no callback, so a provider cannot learn of one
callbacks reach the server only allowlis.stages[account-changed] {provider, at}: ProxyEvent::AccountChanged { provider, at } (v2/model_proxy.rs:646): the account id is not a field of the event

payloads past the aggregate in-flight li.maxInflightBytes / payloadChars / second: ModelProxyService (mixdog-core-domains ai_admin/model_proxy_service.rs admit) refuses as Node's admitPayload does: a call whose payload (the UTF-16 length of the call's JSON as claimed, `payload.length`: claimed_chars) would take the data held by the calls in flight past maxInflightBytes (recorded as 3,000; the service's default is Node's 256 MiB) is the failure MODEL_PROXY_BUSY, status 429, with Node's words, before any provider is looked up, and a call past 128 MiB is MODEL_PROXY_REQUEST_TOO_LARGE (413); replayed from the wire through the server's admission by the_recorded_burst_and_refusal_reach_the_real_model_proxy_service_from_the_wire and by a_call_that_would_take_the_data_held_past_its_bound_is_refused_as_busy; a frame past maxInboundFrameBytes is refused before it is parsed (mixdog-app-protocol/src/rpc.rs:142), tested by a_peer_holds_at_most_its_in_flight_runs_each_one_bounded_frame
payloads past the aggregate in-flight li.oversizedReply / hostOperations: a run sends notifications and asks the peer nothing (model_proxy_service.rs RunEvents::emit), so there is no peer reply to bound; any inbound frame is under the same frame bound
